---
title: "Wood Provision"
---

This site presents the **wood provision ecosystem service accounts** of the European Union for 2000, 2006, 2012, 2018 and 2024. Wood provision
is the ecological contribution to the production of timber that can be harvested and used as a raw material. The accounts measure the net annual
increment of forest available for wood supply, compare it with removals to separate the sustainable flow from overuse, value these quantities and map
them over the forest of each year.

The [report](documentation/methods/wood-provision/index.qmd) describes the methods, the decisions taken along the way and the results. The
[Downloads](downloads/index.qmd) page holds the tables by NUTS region and the 100 m maps. The numbered scripts in the folder
<https://github.com/renatovargas/jrc-wood-provision/tree/main/scripts> reproduce the work, and Annex I of the report explains each of them.
